etsy.title: Funny Hockey Poster, Penalty Box 2:00 for Being Too Good Print, Beer League Wall Art, Hockey Player Gift, Garage Decor
etsy.description:
A funny hockey poster for anyone who has done 2:00 in the penalty box for being too good, in a retro computer window with two choices: Serve or Argue.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, game room, home bar, or basement.

This listing is a physical poster print. Generic design: no league, team, or club marks. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Penalty box jokes are mostly metal signs and digital files; retro and spa-themed penalty posters were shown at about $19.99.
One retro Penalty Box print is sold at 11 x 17 in on cardstock.
Amazon hockey posters are mostly straight sports art for man caves and garages; funny ones are mostly metal signs.

research.notes: No hockey keyword file exists yet, so this rests on one Etsy and one Amazon search. Prices were mixed across signs and posters, so no priceRange is recorded.
